purpose: Coordinator-owned interface for the concurrent numerical producer and scorer. No external component is imported or modified by this package.

producer_entry.mask_storage: Two immutable bytes objects, uint8 C-order, 432x768 = 331776 bytes each. The admitted object exposes immutable NumPy views.
producer_entry.rows: Original ordered CSV-value object_boxes and object_ignore_regions, with no float32 narrowing or altered conversion/tie ordering. New producer must prove original serialized values are preserved.
producer_entry.source_attachment: evidence.admit_source_evidence(input_metadata, avo_document, expected_capture_identity) owns full original metadata and AVO document. Use its content_sha256 as artifact_source_sha256 and its avo_document_sha256 in the target; evidence.reconcile_source(target, source) proves numerical/source agreement. Keep this attachment owned until the archive finishes.
producer_entry.no_png_requirement: Target manifest rows containing PNG hashes belong to deferred evidence; admission does not require their premature construction. Raw numerical semantic digest is explicitly distinct from the legacy prepared-target digest.

scorer_entry.ownership: Masks are bytes-backed read-only NumPy views; metadata maps and ordered sequences are deeply immutable. No original-source reads, PNG decoding or repeated numerical admission occurs in this accessor.
scorer_entry.prediction_responsibility: The scorer must independently retain full original prediction record validation and numerical semantics. The event join checks opaque prediction bytes and checksum only, not those numerical fields.
scorer_entry.result_responsibility: Return exact measurement and matching associations; deferred evidence reconstruction remains necessary and is not implemented by this interface.

wire.behavior: Bounded header and finite JSON metadata plus two fixed-size raw masks, full integrity and identity checks on receiving admission. Ready stamps do not alter action-open.
wire.not_yet_implemented: Authenticated live socket publisher, live pose reconciliation and actual runtime broker wiring. A checksum is not publisher authentication.

source_verification.behavior: Verify exact bytes, compile those retained bytes with their original future-import semantics, and verify disk pins again at postflight. The numerical worker must execute these bytes, not reopen paths or silently import unbound code.

scheduling.behavior: Reserve complete identities and bounded storage; one ordered provisional history computation at a time; admit numerical completion and exact send confirmation before history commit/publication. Join prediction and target by notification, not periodic polling. Timeout never silently evicts an accepted frame.
scheduling.archive: Scoring/feedback and archival completion are independent. Reservations remain until consumers acknowledge release; archive failure invalidates the run without erasing a previously emitted feedback count.
scheduling.history_limit: The controller currently operates on opaque history receipts. Actual stationary/conflict producer ownership is not yet integrated or parity-proven. Do not infer that deep-copying the growing tracker is required or already implemented.
scheduling.integration_strategy_to_verify: Prefer one private serial producer with no next request before confirmation; any failed post-plan transmission faults/ends that session before speculative state can be reused. Verify this against the actual retained fault contract before enabling. If any nonfatal post-plan cancellation must continue, exact rollback or isolated deltas are required.
scheduling.remaining: Real plan-hook dispatch and send-event bridge, complete FrameContext identity checks, source handle lifetime across actual worker/archiver, worker cancellation, and runtime startup/teardown proof remain.

offline_reference_helpers.legacy_bridge: oracle_bridge.from_legacy uses the old full target validator only to derive fixtures. It MUST NOT become the new live producer, because that would retain PNG restoration on readiness.
offline_reference_helpers.artifact_ownership: evidence.own_legacy_reference retains full original target tables and the old prepared digest for offline reference checks.
offline_reference_helpers.replay_command: env -u PYTHONPATH CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 /usr/bin/python3 -B -m rl_agent.splitfusion_numeric_gt_integration_v1.replay_contract --output <fresh-output-directory>
offline_reference_helpers.replay_scope: 49 unique sealed target imports/wire roundtrips with 8 undefined-quality cases. Not a numerical producer/scorer replacement run, actual tracker transaction proof, timing benchmark or live qualification.

next_gate: Integrate the external producer and scorer only after their exact-parity reports are available. Run full-path offline correctness before serial performance measurement. No live run or deadline claim is authorized by this interface.
